summary: Duos Technologies Group filed an 8-K regarding the purchase of a building and land in Columbus, Georgia for use as a data center. The purchase price was $15 million in cash plus a Seller Contingent Earnout Note allowing up to $15 million additional payments based on achieving three power-delivery milestones of 5 MW each. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor is named. This is a real estate acquisition for operational use, not a special situation. What to watch: milestone achievement and potential stock issuance at seller's option.
